key.cyanotype.main: Tool wheel (hold) / start or stop editing (tap)
key.cyanotype.mirror: Mirror the build (left and right as you see it)
key.cyanotype.paste: Paste the build into the world (creative, your own world)
key.cyanotype.help: How it works (the lesson of the tool you are using, or the list of lessons)
key.cyanotype.auto: Auto-placing on or off (comes back in the mode you used last)
key.cyanotype.layer_up: Layers: move the window up one layer (past the top shows all)
key.cyanotype.layer_down: Layers: move the window down one layer
